_comment: #937 'Use recommended' on the Graphic packs tab. A game entry applies when one of its packs belongs to the selected game. 'enable': packs to turn on, with presets per category; a preset is either one name or {seriesX, seriesS, pc}. 'disable': packs to turn off. Paths are the pack's path= in rules.txt (community graphic packs). Resolutions: Series X 1440p (4K where it holds the frame rate), Series S 1080p, PC like Series X.
